positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Miami/Fort Lauderdale y alrededores, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Maintain existing company web application that manages OTC/Medication prescriptions or orders built with ExtJS Framework for the UI and ASP.NET MVC v4 for backend. Specific improvements were decreasing the average waiting time for processing an order from 35 seconds to less than 1 second by optimizing backend code, database queries and applying data caching.   

Maintain and improved by adding new features including data retention/offline capabilities to a iOS Delivery Management application build with Xamarin, C#. Backend .net web service ASP.net 4.5

Developed in a team the company's Provider Portal. It helped remove the burden of work from the service department. Now Providers can get the information, status of a member or claim, online referrals etc, through the portal. Build with ASP.net MVC 4.5 C#, implements 2 factor authentication.

Developed a web application that assess the health risk of its members, previously this was done by pen and paper. This allowed the company to process and analyze this data quickly through the application reporting section. Report Graph where done with D3.JS. MVC 4.5 C# for the Backend

Developed an internal web application that merges and helps maintain information from various sub systems with an user friendly and responsive UI. Developed with ASP.NET MVC 4.5.1 C# for backend and AngularJS Front End.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Maintained a web application for an accounting firm, developed new modules in human resources. Using Python Django Framework and Postgresql for database.

Participated in developing a mobile game using Phonegap, Javascript for the game and django framework for backend with postgressql database.

Maintained an educational web application for a private school built with Zend framework from March 2009 to October 2009.

Build personal portfolio using wordpress and mysql.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a new POS (Point of Sale) for the biggest company’s client that better covered the client’s needs in marketing. Such as discounts, promotions, combos, client segmentation and integration to their current backend. Technologies used: C# .net v4.5 for the desktop client, MSSQL SERVER 2008 database and Django Framework for web administration interface.

Designed and implemented a supporting desktop application that covered most needed solutions for multiple departments such as accounting, warehousing, sales and marketing. Technologies used: C# .net Framework 2 to 4.5 for the client, with MSSQL server 2000 database. The application was maintained through time and upgraded.

Lead the development of red meat and chicken meat production control. It covered weight distribution controls, meat cuts count and final production indicators. Technologies used: C# .NET v4.5 for desktop client and MSSQL server 2008 Database.

Designed and developed a web application that handled quotes from suppliers. The quotes had to pass through an approval system that notified the head of department to approve or deny the purchase via email and electronic signature. It was made with ASP.NET MVC v3 with C# and mssqlserver 2008 for database.

Lead the development of a warehouse and shipping web application using C# .net v4.5 with ASP.NET MVC 3, MSSQL Server 2008 database. The website worked in conjunction with a touch screen application that registered pallets movement information, it was developed with WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation) with C# .net v4.5

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented Gift Card mechanism to existing credit system. This solution was made in python with the Django Framework and Postgresql for database.

Participated with a team to design and build a web application that managed the company’s assets. Resulting in improvements in the accounting department in control and efficiency. This solution was made in python with the Django Framework and Postgresql for database.

Created tools that analyzed client’s expenses that helped the marketing department to create contest and give prizes to the most loyal clients. This solution was made in python with the Django Framework and Postgresql for database.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked with a team to create a web application that would connect with SAP backend to retrieve and manage merchandise orders that Almacenes DePrati needed from its suppliers. Technologies used: ASP.NET, VB.NET, MSSQLSERVER 2005 for database.
